_doc: Learned mapping rules, applied by pipeline/mapper.py BEFORE the scorer (first match wins).
pattern: matched against the FOLDED title (lowercase, no diacritics, punctuation -> space).
plain text  -> whole-word match of the folded pattern ('pro psy' matches 'konzerva pro psy s hovezim')
'sub:...'   -> raw substring match of the folded pattern
're:...'    -> regular expression (case-insensitive) on the folded title
store: '*' for every store or one of albert|lidl|kaufland|tesco|billa|penny|globus.
ingredientId: an id from catalog/ingredients.json, or 'ignore' to drop the offer.
note: free text (why the rule exists). The review panel appends rules here.
